items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: I would sing when I was putting him and my other son, Sidney, and them, but they were babies almost.

ctx.x: What kind of Mardi Gras song? That's a Mardi Gras song. That's a what kind of Mardi Gras song? That's a Mardi Gras song. Did you ever try to play those songs your mother was singing on your clarinet when you were younger? No, no, no. What? I wondered if George ever tried to play any of those songs when he'd hear you sing them, and you picked up your clarinet if you used to practice on them.
No, because you see, I would sing when I was putting him and my other son, Sidney, and them, but they were babies almost.
What sort of songs did you used to sing when you were putting them to sleep?
